messages:
Maya: Quick check — can we run a dedicated throughput sweep for continuous-batching warmup + dropout thresholds on llm-quant-2 (13B q8)? Need to validate p95 under small-burst traffic before the rollout tomorrow.
Andre: SG. Which knobs do you want in the sweep? max_batch_tokens / queue_window_ms / warmup_eviction / dropout_threshold?
Maya: All of the above. Target matrix: max_batch_tokens = [4096, 8192, 16384], queue_window_ms = [10, 20, 50], warmup_eviction (soft-lease eviction) = [0.05, 0.15, 0.3], dropout_threshold = [0.05, 0.15, 0.25].
Linh: Heads-up — my PR #2456 changed soft-lease bookkeeping (reduced lease extension). If we run the sweep without SOFT_LEASE=1 it might over-evict. Recommend setting SOFT_LEASE=1 for parity with prod intent.
Rowan: I can run the loadgen tonight if we agree on dataset. Do we want a mixed prompt distribution (chat-like short + long-context doc queries)?
Maya: Yes — 70% short (avg 60 tokens), 25% medium (avg 450 tokens), 5% long (avg 1500 tokens). Also simulate bursty arrival: Poisson background + short bursts (200 rps for 10s every 2 mins).
Andre: Example command for the runner (staging cluster):

```
rwi-loadgen run --model llm-quant-2 --profile cb-warmup-sweep --matrix "max_batch_tokens=4096,8192,16384;queue_window_ms=10,20,50;warmup_eviction=0.05,0.15,0.3;dropout_threshold=0.05,0.15,0.25" --prometheus-endpoint http://ops-staging:9090 --duration 40m --seed 42
```

Andre: We'll capture p50/p95/p99, tokens_per_sec, batch_fill_pct, and cold_start_rate per-window.
Rowan: I'll kick off a smoke run now for the baseline (max_batch_tokens=8192, queue_window_ms=20, warmup_eviction=0.15, dropout_threshold=0.15). Will paste logs in a sec.
Rowan: quick smoke log snippet:

```
[00:02] batches_sent=1200 tokens_out=1450000 tokens/sec=12083 p50_lat_ms=85 p95_lat_ms=210 p99_lat_ms=370 avg_batch_fill=0.62 cold_start_rate=0.04
[00:07] batches_sent=2400 tokens_out=2900000 tokens/sec=12100 p50_lat_ms=88 p95_lat_ms=215 p99_lat_ms=385 avg_batch_fill=0.60 cold_start_rate=0.06
```

Rowan: looks reasonable for baseline. p95 ~210-215ms on staging GPUs.
Maya: Nice. Can we also log per-model-kv-cache-hit for long queries? If cache hit drops, we should correlate with eviction thresholds.
Linh: Adding note — please include env var SOFT_LEASE=1 and set FALLBACK_SMALL_BATCH_IF_FILL_LT=0.3 for 5m in the runner so we can validate fallback behavior.
Andre: I'll open a tiny helper script to synthesize the burst pattern and trigger the sweep from CI. PR incoming: #2479. @Rowan can you review the test harness? It's small.
Rowan: Reviewing now. Quick comment: the harness assumes queue_window_ms applied cluster-wide; it should be per-model override. I'll add one line.
ci-bot: Scheduled nightly run: job_id=7890, queue=staging-cb-sweeps, eta=2026-03-18T03:00:00Z — will post artifacts to /sweeps/1976549876/
Maya: Perfect. Please capture these metrics in the artifacts: p50/p95/p99 per config, median tokens/sec, batch_fill percentile, cold_start_rate, and any throttled/fallback events.
Andre: Also add a column for avg batch wait time and the distribution of batch sizes (histogram). That helps explain low fill scenarios.
Rowan: smoke run note: I saw a short spike where avg_batch_fill dropped to 0.28 for ~30s when a backgroundal batch of long queries hit. That triggered the fallback correctly with FALLBACK_SMALL_BATCH_IF_FILL_LT=0.3 :+1:
Maya: Good — that's the behavior we want. If nightly sweep shows too many fallback events at target traffic, we'll have to raise warmup_eviction or reduce dropout_threshold.
Linh: Small caution — raising warmup_eviction can increase cold_start_rate for long queries. We'll need to balance.
Maya: Agreed. Plan: collect sweep, collate results in a short dashboard, then decide rollback/rollout tomorrow AM. I'll file follow-up ticket: RW-3812 for tuning based on results.
Andre: Pinged infra to bump staging slot quota for the night. ops-bot: quota bump request created (ticket INF-9123).
ops-bot: INF-9123 updated — staging GPU quota +2 for 12h starting 2026-03-18T01:30:00Z.
Rowan: OK I'll leave loadgen running overnight and send a post-run summary in the morning.
Maya: Thanks all. @Andre @Linh @Rowan please thumbs-up the PRs when you get a sec. :thumbsup:
Andre: :thumbsup:
Linh: :thumbsup:
